fatal_errors: No specific glass-forming material or alloy composition is identified.
The proposed intervention of iterative experiment-simulation feedback is not the compositional modification and melt-spinning intervention studied in the target.
The initial state is incorrectly described as amorphous rather than an elemental alloy charge subsequently solidified under different cooling conditions.
No mechanism involving eutectic-dominated solidification, suppression of segregation, or inhibition of phosphide nucleation is provided.
The falsification experiment lacks defined compositions, cooling rates, controls, and structural measurements.
explanation: The hypothesis only recognizes the broad idea that alloy composition and rapid cooling can affect metallic-glass formation. It fails to identify Fe22Ni16Co19Mn12Cr16P15, the Fe/Co/Mn adjustment and reduction to 15 at.% P, or melt spinning at 40 m/s to form approximately 20 micrometer amorphous ribbons. It also omits the key comparison with Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20 and the crystalline arc-melted ingot, as well as the eutectic-growth and phosphide-suppression mechanism. The predicted outcome is circular, and the proposed test cannot discriminate the target mechanism from generic optimization.
